project: Norfolk Vanguard — ICT Loop Testing & Commissioning
notes: Figures are transcribed from the 'Loop Testing Status' tables in each daily look-ahead email.
progressThrough is the day the figures describe; reportDate is the day the email was sent.
null means the report did not state that figure.
From the 15 Oct report onwards the first row was renamed from 'CPCLs Commenced (Instrument I/O)' to 'HW Loop References Commenced' and described as a reconciled tracker total.

constraints.title: Valve command vs feedback
